note: Validate whether the risk gate from job 0041 is a real, deployable day-selector. 0041 showed risk-gated baskets with huge info ratios (Top3 IR=5.16) but used_days collapsed from 15 to 6 (identical across k=1..10), implying ~9 days have the whole pool risk_flagged. That 5.16 is on a 6-day selected subsample and is NOT directly usable. This job freezes v10_amt ranking and compares, on the FULL 15-day basis (sit-out days counted as 0 excess so opportunity cost is included): always_top{1,2,3} (trade every day, current behavior) vs daygate_top{1,2,3} (trade only on clean days where >=k non-risk names exist, else cash). Reports per-day breakdown (date/regime/n_clean/all_top3), whether risk_flag is effectively day-level (sat-out days fully flagged), and the avoided-day P&L (sum of always_top3 excess on the sat-out days: negative=gate saved you, positive=gate cost you). Output reports/_audit/premarket_daygate_validation_v33.{json,md}.
